Input UI components for the dittoFreqPlot module

Source: R/dittoFreqPlot_module_ui.R
dittoFreqPlotInputsUI.Rd

This should be placed in the UI where the inputs should be shown, with an id that matches the id used in the dittoFreqPlotServer() and dittoFreqPlotOutputUI() functions.

Usage

dittoFreqPlotInputsUI(
  id,
  data,
  defaults = NULL,
  title = "FreqPlot Settings",
  columns = 2
)

Arguments

id

The ID for the Shiny module.

data

A SingleCellExperiment, Seurat, or SummarizedExperiment object used to populate the input choices.

defaults

A named list of default values for the inputs.

title

An optional title for the UI grid.

columns

Number of columns for the UI grid.

Value

A Shiny tagList containing the UI elements

Details

The user inputs for this module are separated from the outputs to allow for more flexible UI design.

This module wraps dittoSeq::dittoFreqPlot(), which computes the per-sample frequency (or count) of each level of a discrete var and plots those frequencies across groups as jitter/box/violin/ridge representations. The resulting ggplot is converted to an interactive plotly figure.

Plot parameters and defaults

The following parameters can be accessed via UI inputs and/or the defaults argument:

  • var - Discrete metadata whose frequencies are computed

  • sample.by - Discrete metadata identifying individual samples

  • group.by - Discrete metadata used for the x-axis groups

  • color.by - Discrete metadata used for fill colors (default: group.by)

  • scale - "percent" or "count" (default: "percent")

  • plots - Representations to draw (default: c("boxplot", "jitter"))

  • max.normalize - Scale each facet to its own max (default: FALSE)

  • jitter.size - Jitter point size (default: 1)

  • jitter.width - Horizontal spread of the jitter points (default: 0.2)

  • jitter.color - Color of the jitter points (default: "#000000")

  • boxplot.width - Width of the boxplots (default: 0.4)

  • vlnplot.width - Relative width of the violins (default: 1)

  • palette.selection - Colors for discrete groups (multiColorPicker)

See also

dittoSeq::dittoFreqPlot(), VizModules::organize_inputs(), dittoFreqPlotOutputUI(), dittoFreqPlotServer(), dittoFreqPlotApp()

Author

Jacob Martin, Jared Andrews

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
data(example_sce)
dittoFreqPlotInputsUI("dittoFreqPlot", example_sce)
